Good questions.
Clear answers.
faq.description: A little clarity makes the next step easier.

items.question: Where is PawSupply based, and do you own the factories?
items.answer: PawSupply is based in China and has long-term relationships with dozens of partner factories. We are your sourcing and coordination partner; the factories are cooperation partners, not presented as facilities we own. Production arrangements and requirements are confirmed for each order.

items.question: What is the minimum order quantity?
items.answer: Minimums vary by product, material and customization. Share your preferred category and estimated quantity; the applicable minimum will be confirmed in your quote.

items.question: Can I customize branding and packaging?
items.answer: Share your logo, color, material and packaging requirements. Available options, sampling costs and lead times will be confirmed in a written proposal after product review.

items.question: Can I review samples before a bulk order?
items.answer: Include your sample request in your inquiry. Sample availability, costs and shipping will be confirmed for the selected product. We recommend approving final specifications before a bulk order.

items.question: What information do you need for a quote?
items.answer: Please include product categories, estimated quantity, target market, delivery location and customization needs. Reference images, materials and target budgets are also helpful.

items.question: Can you arrange shipments from different ports in China?
items.answer: Yes. We support shipments from the ports of Xiamen, Tianjin and Guangzhou in China, with coordination across multiple logistics channels. The departure port, route, freight costs and timing are confirmed for each shipment based on cargo and destination requirements.
